decisions.reason: Changing the fiat on-ramp provider to Transak does not change the independently selected Brevo transactional email transport.
The provider change does not alter the $5 automatic referral commission amount or payout mode.
Selecting Transak for fiat minting does not change email-based dashboard access for users without wallets.
The fiat on-ramp provider choice does not affect whether public data APIs require authentication.
The Transak selection does not change publication of prize-pool values through public APIs.
Transak applies to the fiat path and does not change SIWE authentication for crypto minting and transfers.
The fiat on-ramp provider decision has no effect on badge selection, naming, or icon presentation.
Changing the fiat payment provider does not alter ticket allocation for successful mints without referral codes.
The provider switch does not change prize-ticket issuance or lifecycle rules for successful referral mints.
The Transak selection does not change the trigger for awarding the First Referral badge.
